text:
Janet: Heads-up — ACME legal is pushing for 99.99% uptime on Hosted API + 50ms p95 for their chat endpoint. Sales needs a clear product feasibility note and escalation routing to attach to the contract. @sasha @miguel please advise

Sasha: 99.99% on shared hosted is unlikely without reserved capacity. Need to confirm whether they will accept Dedicated or a commercial tradeoff (credits). What commit size are they signing?

Ella: $120k/mo initial commit, prefer hosted for simplicity but open if pricing for Dedicated is explicit.

Leo: Support telemetry: last 30d short-chat p95 (us-east) = 112ms, p50 = 30ms. Periodic tail spikes at peak. No active incidents. Link to internal logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/acme/short-chat

Miguel: quick take: 50ms p95 on Hosted is unrealistic given current multi-tenant routing + KV warmup. Options:
- Dedicated reserved pool: achievable 40-60ms p95 depending on GPU and model quantization
- Hosted with contractual best-effort + credits and mandatory baseline perf window
- Regional routing + warm standby variants to reduce tails (still best-effort)

Sasha: propose we create a short intake doc that Sales can include in the MSA describing: feasibility, required commitments, and fallback language. Also need an intake workflow so triage is consistent.

Janet: yes — Sales asked for wording by EOD. Can Product produce a one-page intake + routing matrix and an escalation playbook we can attach?

Sasha: will draft. Proposed intake workflow:
1) Sales opens PROD-INTAKE with contract clause + requested SLOs
2) Product triage within 48h: eng feasibility + cost delta
3) If feasible: baseline perf run (7 days) -> final SLO signoff -> infra changes planned
4) If infeasible: present alternative (Dedicated or credit model) and escalation path

Miguel: technical checklist to include in the intake ticket (I'll add these):
- estimated steady qps and peak bursts
- typical request seq len and model family
- regions and latency constraints
- tolerance for fallback model or increased latency
- required retention / logging

Leo: Support side — escalation & mitigation appendix draft:
- On breach or sustained p95 degradation: page eng-oncall with tag "customer-slo"
- Immediate mitigations: (a) route traffic to customer's Dedicated pool if available, (b) enable warm-standby model variant, (c) temporarily increase reserved burst capacity
- Notify CS + AE within 30m and provide status cadence

Sasha: credit formula sketch for Legal (to be refined):
```
If monthly uptime < SLA, credits = min(30% of monthly fee, floor((SLA - observed_uptime)/SLA * 100%) * monthly_fee)
Latency breaches: if p95 > target for more than X contiguous hours, apply tiered credit 1%, 3%, 10% depending on duration
```

Ella: Legal will want deterministic math and observability spec (how uptime/latency measured, time windows, excluded maintenance). Also need explicit contact for escalations.

Janet: product launch criteria for a negotiated SLO clause — what should Sales expect before contract signature?

Sasha: launch/checklist items:
- Baseline perf run completed and engineering signoff
- Mitigation playbook including fallback routing and warm cache strategy
- Monitoring & alerting configured with runbooks attached
- Support tier and 24/7 escalation contact documented
- Migration plan if customer later moves to Dedicated

Miguel: I'll draft a recommended Dedicated config (GPU type, pool size, warm-cache policy) and a perf test plan. Will include warmup scripts and QPS profile. ETA tomorrow noon.

Leo: I'll write customer-facing incident notice templates and produce an example credit calc spreadsheet for Legal. ETA EOD.

Sasha: I'll put the 1-pager intake template + routing matrix into product/contract-templates and link it from the PROD-INTAKE ticket. ETA 6pm PT today.

product-bot: Ticket created: PROD-INTAKE-9472 (ACME SLA feasibility) — assignees: sasha,miguel,leo. Link: https://redwood.internal/boards/PROD-INTAKE-9472

Janet: scheduling triage at 14:30 today. If triage flags Hosted as non-viable, we need fallback commercial language immediately so Sales can reply to the customer.

Miguel: note — recommend mandatory 7-day perf baseline before contract effective date to establish realistic SLOs and any required Dedicated sizing.

Ella: please cc me on the intake ticket and the 1-pager so I can attach pricing and loop in Legal.

Sasha: action items recap:
- Sasha: 1-pager intake + matrix (6pm PT)
- Miguel: Dedicated sizing + perf plan (tomorrow 12:00)
- Leo: Support runbook + credit calc example (EOD)
- Ella/Janet: Legal/pricing coordination (ASAP)

Janet: thanks all — this doc will be attached to the contract draft. Keep updates in the PROD-INTAKE ticket.
